parsed.note_claim: During Nov 15, 2025 protests in Mexico City, demonstrators tore down barriers and clashed with police, but police used tear gas to maintain control, and the National Palace was not overrun.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: Demonstrators dismantled parts of a barrier protecting the National Palace, where Sheinbaum lives. Police protecting the compound used tear gas on the crowds.
parsed.reason: The BBC article directly confirms that protesters dismantled barriers, clashed with police, and police used tear gas, with no indication the palace was overrun.
